data_description.update_check_interval: Docker Hub counts every check as a pull; 360 = every 6 hours.
data_description.enable_release_notes: Reads the image label org.opencontainers.image.source and shows the GitHub releases since the running image.
data_description.release_note_sources: Pairs image=owner/repo, comma separated, e.g. redis=redis/redis, headscale/headscale=juanfont/headscale. Takes precedence over the label.
data_description.watchtower_url: Leave empty to install updates through Portainer as before. With a URL, Watchtower on the Docker host installs them (HTTP API with the "update" endpoint) - which also works for Portainer itself, its agent and the proxy in front of it.
data_description.watchtower_token: Not shown again; leave empty to keep the stored token.
